about: RULING 2 (fix/htf-exchange-day), the coordinator's ruling (C): a resampler keys an INTRADAY series' bars by the exchange's local (New York) session date, never their UTC date (a daily series keeps its dates, one stamped at midnight UTC included); both lanes keep every bar the series holds in a higher-timeframe aggregate; the closure-week withhold waits for Q-REQ-CLOSURE, and a tripwire pins why no served series reaches it. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.
